title: 隧道岩栓拉拔驗證
summary: 本課以辨識岩栓鋼材、漿體與岩體界面的拉拔傳力為主線，從岩楔荷重與岩栓方向與鋼材屈服與有效面積建立系統邊界，再把自由段伸長與系統柔度、持載位移與時間效應連到試驗代表性與補強決策。單支拉拔只檢驗局部系統，不能直接證明整個岩楔穩定。 十單元以可核算的模型和可追溯證據逐步判讀不同失效。
summaryEn: This course focuses on distinguish bolt steel, grout and rock interfaces in pullout load transfer. It begins with Wedge weight and bolt direction and Steel yielding and effective area, links Free-length extension and system compliance and Hold movement and time effects, and ends with Representativeness and reinforcement decisions. A single pull test examines a local system and does not establish whole-wedge stability. Ten units use reproducible models and traceable evidence to distinguish failure mechanisms.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 整合算例所有輸入均為教學假設。首先檢查岩楔荷重與岩栓方向：W=gamma*V=26 kN/m3*4 m3=104 kN; two symmetric vertical bolts carry 52 kN each；再獨立檢查鋼材屈服與有效面積：Ny=A*fy=314 mm2*500 N/mm2=157000 N=157 kN。假想岩楔由 4 增為 5 m3，單位重 26 kN/m3 不變，重量由 104 增為 130 kN；兩支垂直岩栓只有在理想對稱下才各分擔 65 kN。 兩個結果不能自動組成完整設計，因為單支拉拔只檢驗局部系統，不能直接證明整個岩楔穩定。 將用可追溯荷重元比較不同荷重階段及載卸方向作為模型以外的驗證證據，並保留原始紀錄與尚待確認的邊界。
workedExample.textEn: All inputs in this integrated example are teaching assumptions. First check Wedge weight and bolt direction: W=gamma*V=26 kN/m3*4 m3=104 kN; two symmetric vertical bolts carry 52 kN each. Independently check Steel yielding and effective area: Ny=A*fy=314 mm2*500 N/mm2=157000 N=157 kN. Increasing assumed wedge volume from 4 to 5 m3 at 26 kN/m3 raises weight from 104 to 130 kN; two vertical bolts share 65 kN each only under ideal symmetry. The two results are not a complete design because a single pull test examines a local system and does not establish whole-wedge stability. Use compare traceable load-cell readings across force levels and loading directions as evidence independent of the calculation, retaining raw records and unverified boundaries.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 地層條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.titleEn: Ground conditions, boundaries and engineering system
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「岩楔荷重與岩栓方向」與「鋼材屈服與有效面積」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Wedge weight and bolt direction" and "Steel yielding and effective area": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 岩楔荷重與岩栓方向：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Wedge weight and bolt direction: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「岩楔荷重與岩栓方向」如何影響隧道岩栓拉拔驗證的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Wedge weight and bolt direction” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Tunnel rock-bolt pullout verification”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 岩栓能否穩住岩楔取決於節理幾何、摩擦以及力的方向，而非單看根數。垂直分量必須平衡重力，水平分量可能改變節理正向力；將所有岩栓當成平均分擔會忽略偏心與先後受力，需先畫出可移動岩塊的自由體圖。 判別這個機制時，應觀察將節理交線、岩楔體積與岩栓方向畫在同一量測圖；若出現岩栓未穿越滑動面，試驗合格仍可能隨岩楔一起掉落，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「岩楔荷重與岩栓方向」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Wedge restraint depends on joint geometry, friction and bolt orientation rather than count alone. Vertical components balance gravity while horizontal components can modify joint normal force. Equal sharing ignores eccentricity and sequential engagement, so first isolate the movable block in a free-body diagram. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Plot joint intersections, wedge volume and bolt directions in the same surveyed geometry. If a bolt not crossing the sliding surface can pass a pull test yet fall with the wedge, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Wedge weight and bolt direction” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：W=gamma*V=26 kN/m3*4 m3=104 kN; two symmetric vertical bolts carry 52 kN each。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: W=gamma*V=26 kN/m3*4 m3=104 kN; two symmetric vertical bolts carry 52 kN each.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「岩栓數量足夠便不必考慮節理方向」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Enough bolts remove the need to consider joint orientation" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「岩楔荷重與岩栓方向」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.title: 岩楔荷重與岩栓方向：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Wedge weight and bolt direction: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「岩楔荷重與岩栓方向」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Wedge weight and bolt direction” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：W=gamma*V=26 kN/m3*4 m3=104 kN; two symmetric vertical bolts carry 52 kN each。單支拉拔只檢驗局部系統，不能直接證明整個岩楔穩定。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: W=gamma*V=26 kN/m3*4 m3=104 kN; two symmetric vertical bolts carry 52 kN each. A single pull test examines a local system and does not establish whole-wedge stability. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將節理交線、岩楔體積與岩栓方向畫在同一量測圖。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Plot joint intersections, wedge volume and bolt directions in the same surveyed geometry.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 岩楔荷重與岩栓方向：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Wedge weight and bolt direction: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「岩楔荷重與岩栓方向」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Wedge weight and bolt direction” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將節理交線、岩楔體積與岩栓方向畫在同一量測圖。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「岩栓未穿越滑動面，試驗合格仍可能隨岩楔一起掉落」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Plot joint intersections, wedge volume and bolt directions in the same surveyed geometry. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: A bolt not crossing the sliding surface can pass a pull test yet fall with the wedge. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將將節理交線、岩楔體積與岩栓方向畫在同一量測圖列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現岩栓未穿越滑動面，試驗合格仍可能隨岩楔一起掉落，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。

Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If a bolt not crossing the sliding surface can pass a pull test yet fall with the wedge, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：岩栓未穿越滑動面，試驗合格仍可能隨岩楔一起掉落。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A bolt not crossing the sliding surface can pass a pull test yet fall with the wedge. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

steps.title: 岩楔荷重與岩栓方向：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Wedge weight and bolt direction: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「岩楔荷重與岩栓方向」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Wedge weight and bolt direction” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 岩栓未穿越滑動面，試驗合格仍可能隨岩楔一起掉落。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到將節理交線、岩楔體積與岩栓方向畫在同一量測圖，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A bolt not crossing the sliding surface can pass a pull test yet fall with the wedge. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to plot joint intersections, wedge volume and bolt directions in the same surveyed geometry to discriminate the cause. steps.instruction: 沿錨固段的剪應力通常不均勻，受拉端先動員而遠端可能尚未充分參與。均勻黏結公式只能作平均量級，裂隙、灌漿空洞與孔壁擾動會減少有效長度；提高漿體抗壓也不一定改善岩漿界面的剪力傳遞。 判別這個機制時，應觀察以拉拔曲線配對灌漿量、孔徑和可用孔內影像；若出現漿體空洞縮短有效長度，使局部剪應力提早達峰，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「漿體黏結與有效長度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：bearingStress=80 kN/0.020 m2=4 MPa; half the contact area gives 8 MPa。單支拉拔只檢驗局部系統，不能直接證明整個岩楔穩定。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。

steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.instruction: 觀察托盤接觸印跡、轉角及周圍岩面裂紋。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「托盤下薄片壓碎造成滑移，誤被判成鋼栓延伸」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

steps.title: 自由段伸長與系統柔度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Free-length extension and system compliance: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「自由段伸長與系統柔度」如何影響隧道岩栓拉拔驗證的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Free-length extension and system compliance” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Tunnel rock-bolt pullout verification”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 量到的位移包含自由鋼材伸長、錨固滑移、夾具變形與反力架沉陷。用全長代入純鋼伸長公式會錯把黏結段當成自由段；比較載卸曲線可辨認可回復彈性與不可回復滑移，但仍需要獨立基準才能分離支承移動。 判別這個機制時，應觀察用獨立位移計量測栓頭、夾具及反力架的相對移動；若出現反力架沉陷被計入岩栓位移，造成假性低剛度，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「自由段伸長與系統柔度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Measured movement combines free steel extension, bond slip, grip deformation and reaction-frame settlement. Full-length elastic calculation wrongly treats bonded length as free. Loading-unloading response distinguishes recoverable extension from slip, but independent references are still needed to separate support movement. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Measure relative motion of bolt head, grip and reaction frame with independent gauges. steps.title: 腐蝕損失與局部弱截面：機制與系統路徑

steps.objective: 說明「腐蝕損失與局部弱截面」如何影響隧道岩栓拉拔驗證的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Corrosion loss and local weak sections” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Tunnel rock-bolt pullout verification”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 腐蝕不一定沿全長均勻，孔口水氣和裂縫可能造成局部截面損失。直徑減少對面積有平方影響，局部坑蝕又會加劇應力集中；用平均重量損失推估剩餘承載，需要確認最小截面及腐蝕分布是否已被量到。 判別這個機制時，應觀察檢查孔口防護、水質及可見最小直徑並追蹤時間變化；若出現局部坑蝕被平均失重掩蓋，岩栓在弱截面突然斷裂，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「腐蝕損失與局部弱截面」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Corrosion can concentrate near wet collars and fractures rather than being uniform. Diameter loss changes area quadratically, and pits add stress concentration. Inferring capacity from mean mass loss requires evidence that the minimum section and corrosion distribution have actually been characterized. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Inspect collar protection, water chemistry and visible minimum diameter over time. If local pitting hidden by mean mass loss causes rupture at the weakest section, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Corrosion loss and local weak sections” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

knowledge.text: 依地質、批次及錨固型式建立試驗分層對照表。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「僅測易施工區造成選樣偏差，危險區卻沒有代表資料」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。
knowledge.textEn: Stratify test records by geology, batch and anchorage type. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Testing only easy zones biases the sample and leaves critical zones unrepresented. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將依地質、批次及錨固型式建立試驗分層對照表列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現僅測易施工區造成選樣偏差，危險區卻沒有代表資料，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
knowledge.textEn: Apply the following check at handover: Stratify test records by geology, batch and anchorage type. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If testing only easy zones biases the sample and leaves critical zones unrepresented, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

steps.title: 試驗代表性與補強決策：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Representativeness and reinforcement decisions: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「試驗代表性與補強決策」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Representativeness and reinforcement decisions” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 僅測易施工區造成選樣偏差，危險區卻沒有代表資料。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到依地質、批次及錨固型式建立試驗分層對照表，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Testing only easy zones biases the sample and leaves critical zones unrepresented. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to stratify test records by geology, batch and anchorage type to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察依地質、批次及錨固型式建立試驗分層對照表；若出現僅測易施工區造成選樣偏差，危險區卻沒有代表資料，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If testing only easy zones biases the sample and leaves critical zones unrepresented, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「抽測平均合格就可以證明所有地區的岩栓安全」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A passing sample mean proves bolt safety in every geological zone" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 僅測易施工區造成選樣偏差，危險區卻沒有代表資料。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到依地質、批次及錨固型式建立試驗分層對照表，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。
knowledge.textEn: Testing only easy zones biases the sample and leaves critical zones unrepresented. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to stratify test records by geology, batch and anchorage type to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.
